full_prompt_en: A square retro-industrial science-fiction illustration shows an orange-suited astronaut slumped on a chair among old monitors, cables, and stacked machinery. The astronaut sits on the right half, body bent forward and helmet tilted down toward the knees. A round cream helmet with a dark blue visor ring hides the face. Heavy orange fabric gathers at the shoulders, elbows, and knees, and muted teal gloves hang loosely between the legs. Brown boots plant on a dusty floor crossed by loose red and black wires. On the left, a broad table supports a boxy pale monitor with a dim cyan screen. A second smaller screen glows below it, surrounded by switches, panels, and scattered metal parts. Behind both astronaut and equipment, the wall is packed with pipes, cabinets, hanging cables, and mechanical fragments in olive gray and weathered brown. A pale human head or sculpted bust appears high in the crowded background, partly obscured by the surrounding hardware. The dense arrangement gives the small seated figure a claustrophobic workspace rather than open spaceflight. Fine ink-like outlines define rivets, seams, wire loops, and worn casing edges, while thin matte color washes bind the many objects into one quiet palette. A muted light from the monitor and upper left lifts the helmet, suit folds, and table edge, leaving recesses between machines in deep green-gray shadow. The screens show no legible writing. The overall composition is melancholy and tactile, contrasting a passive curved human posture with the relentless rectangular clutter of aging technology.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形复古工业科幻插画呈现一名身穿橙色服装的宇航员，倦怠地坐在旧显示器、缆线与层叠机械之间。宇航员坐在右半幅，身体前弯，头盔低垂向膝盖。奶油色圆盔配深蓝面罩边环，遮住脸。厚橙色布料在肩、肘和膝处起褶，柔和蓝绿色手套松松垂在双腿间。棕靴踏在布满红黑散线的蒙尘地板上。左侧，一张宽桌托着方正浅色显示器，屏幕发出暗青光。其下另有一块较小屏幕发亮，周围围着开关、面板和散落金属件。宇航员和设备身后的墙面挤满管道、机柜、垂缆和橄榄灰、风化棕色机械碎件。一个浅色人头或雕塑半身像出现在拥挤背景高处，部分被周围硬件遮住。这种密集排列使小小坐者身处逼仄工作间，而非开阔太空飞行。细墨线般轮廓描出铆钉、接缝、线圈和磨旧机壳边，薄哑光色层将众多物件联成安静色盘。显示器和左上方的柔和光抬亮头盔、衣褶与桌缘，机械间凹处留在深绿灰影中。屏幕没有可读文字。整体构图忧郁而可触，以被动弯曲的人体姿态对照陈旧技术无尽的矩形杂物。
style_prompt_en: Retro-industrial science-fiction illustration uses fine technical linework and thin matte washes over densely layered equipment-like forms. Weathered olive, taupe, cream, dim cyan, and concentrated orange create a subdued but distinctive palette. Rectangular masses and looping cables crowd the space, while one soft curved silhouette offers a readable focal pause. Scuffs, dust, and tiny seams make surfaces feel used. Weak local glows and gentle upper light pick out a few edges, leaving compressed recesses deep and cool. The overall effect is intricate, weary, and tactile.
style_prompt_zh: 复古工业科幻插画在密集层叠的设备般形状上运用细技术线描与薄哑光色层。风化橄榄色、灰褐、奶油、暗青和集中的橙色构成柔和却鲜明的色盘。矩形色团与盘绕缆线挤满空间，一个柔软弯曲剪影则提供可读的焦点停顿。擦痕、尘土和细接缝让表面像被使用过。微弱局部光和温和高处光提亮少数边缘，让压缩的凹处深而冷。整体繁复、疲惫且可触。
theme_en: A weary orange-suited astronaut sitting among old monitors and cables
theme_zh: 一名疲惫的橙色服装宇航员坐在旧显示器与缆线之间
name: Josan Gonzalez
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
